# Programmatic participants and category-first references

Represent programmatic software consumers alongside human and agent participants, including the operational conditions or interface requirements relevant to their declared use.

Use dot-separated participant references in the form `<category>.<subject>.<role>`, making the category, subject and role separately visible. Examples are `human.standard.maintainer`, `agent.standard.author` and `human.system.maintainer`. Assigning a participant to a role and granting authority remain explicit records, not consequences of the label.

Apply this through the [authoring guidance](../../standard/application/problem-context-and-actor-language.md#category-first-references-and-programmatic-participants). The program prefix, prospective validator and specific machine-interface requirements remain working proposals; this decision does not choose a format, implement a consumer or rank participant intelligence and speed.
